extracted.name: Superb Sautéed Mushrooms
extracted.description: These sautéed mushrooms with garlic, teriyaki sauce, and a splash of red wine are perfect for topping steaks, pork chops, or baked potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon garlic salt, or to taste
freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add mushrooms, wine, teriyaki sauce, sliced garlic, garlic salt, and black pepper; cook and stir until mushrooms are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer until mushrooms are tender, 5 to 8 more minutes.
